## Dictation
- **No more "Thank you." out of silence.** Offline Whisper models sometimes write subtitle filler such as "Thank you." when they only hear breathing or room noise. WhisperShortcut now drops a short clip (under 2 seconds) that contains nothing but such a phrase. Real sentences are kept. You can switch this off with "Filter known silence hallucinations" in Settings ▸ Dictate.

## Read Aloud
- **Create and clone your own Qwen3 voices.** With the Qwen3 VoiceDesign voice selected (Macs with 32 GB of memory or more), Settings ▸ Read Aloud lets you listen to a voice, create a new one from a description, and keep your own voices. You can also clone a voice from a recording; only do this with the consent of the person it belongs to. The recording stays on your Mac.

## Accounts
- **Own server next to the other providers.** Settings ▸ Accounts now offers your own OpenAI-compatible server alongside Gemini, OpenAI and the others, with presets for LM Studio, MLX and oMLX.

## Installation
Download the DMG from the [releases page](https://github.com/mgsgde/whisper-shortcut/releases), open it, and drag WhisperShortcut to your Applications folder.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/mgsgde/whisper-shortcut/compare/v8.85...v8.86
